description: Search worldmarket.com by keyword, browse a department or collection, or paste product URLs. Prices, sale savings, images, SKUs, variants and optional store pickup. No login or cookies required.

category.description: A World Market department or curated collection. Use `categoryUrl` instead if you want a sub-category that is not listed here.
category.title: Department or collection (mode=byCategory)

categoryUrl.description: A worldmarket.com category or collection URL, e.g. `https://www.worldmarket.com/c/furniture/shop-all-furniture/`. Takes priority over `category`.
categoryUrl.title: Custom category or collection URL (mode=byCategory)

includePickup.description: Add per-store pickup status, quantity and message. Requires `storeId` or `postalCode`.
includePickup.title: Include store pickup availability

includeVariants.description: Include the selectable color, size or fragrance options for products that have them (up to 20).
includeVariants.title: Include variant options

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted products (1–500). Search and department pages are read 120 tiles at a time.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop products whose current price is above this amount.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop products whose current price is below this amount.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

mode.description: What to fetch. `search` uses a keyword, `byCategory` browses a department or collection, and `byProductUrls` reads the URLs you paste.
mode.title: Mode

postalCode.description: US ZIP code used to resolve the nearest store when `storeId` is not set and `includePickup` is enabled.
postalCode.title: ZIP / postal code (optional, pickup only)

productUrls.description: Direct worldmarket.com product-page URLs, e.g. `https://www.worldmarket.com/p/<slug>-<id>.html`. Up to 500 unique URLs per run.
productUrls.title: Product URLs (mode=byProductUrls)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor connects directly first and only uses a proxy fallback if World Market blocks a request. Choose your own proxy to use it as that fallback, or leave it unset.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for (mode=search), e.g. `candle`, `dining chair`, `chocolate`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Sort order for search and department results. `bestselling` and `newArrivals` keep World Market's own listing order.
sortBy.title: Sort order

storeId.description: A World Market store ID such as `store398`. Used only when `includePickup` is enabled. If omitted, the nearest store is resolved from `postalCode`.
storeId.title: Store ID (optional, pickup only)

title: World Market Product Scraper Input
